programme.title: Puls
programme.desc: PULS, emisioni më i ri në A2 CNN, vjen çdo ditë me gazetaren Bruna Çifligu, duke sjellë temat më të nxehta të aktualitetit dhe duke shkuar në zemër të ngjarjeve. Debate, analiza, histori njerëzore, gjithçka që prek shoqërinë dhe politikën në kohë reale.

programme.title: Ditari Pasdites
programme.desc: Ditari, hapësira informative që trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme, kryesisht politike, në 3 edicione qendrore. Analiza nga të ftuar dhe raportime live nga terreni.

programme.title: Rretheqark
programme.desc: ”Rretheqark” është dritarja që hapet çdo mbrëmje mbi botën në lëvizje. Në një orë, zbulojmë labirintet e gjeopolitikës, aty ku pushtetet maten, aleancat ndryshojnë dhe diplomacia shkruan historinë në heshtje. Ju çojmë në prapaskenën e ngjarjeve që përcaktojnë ekuilibrat globale e rajonale. Një udhëtim rretheqark , për të parë jo vetëm çfarë ndodh, por edhe ku po shkon bota dhe rajoni.\r\n”Rretheqark”, cdo mbrëmje në orën, 22:00. Nga Rosalba Bejdo dhe Xhevahir Qardaku.”.

programme.title: Edicioni qendror
programme.desc: Edicioni qendror informativ, hapësira informative që trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme te dites. Analiza nga të ftuar dhe raportime live nga terreni.

programme.title: OFF the Record
programme.desc: ”Off the Record!” me Andrea Danglli ka si qëllim të sjellë në ekran misionin e gazetarisë së thelluar dhe analitike. Emisioni synon shtjellimin e një teme të caktuar që shqetëson shoqërinë nga e shkuara apo aktualiteti duke zbuluar përgjigjet e pikëpyetjeve të ngritura nga qytetarët përmes zërit të tyre, debatit apo informacionit për publikun.

programme.desc: Dokumentarë të zhanreve të ndryshëm, kulturë, ekonomi, turizëm, kulinari, modë/stil, shëndet, sociale, sport.

programme.title: Pumpkinhead
programme.desc: After his son dies in a hit-and-run accident, Ed Harley seeks revenge against the teenagers responsible. With the help of a local witch, Ed summons the vengeful demon Pumpkinhead to hunt and kill the group of friends. But when Ed discovers a bond between himself and the creature, he begins to have second thoughts about employing the vicious monster, and he fights to end Pumpkinhead's murderous rampage before it is too late.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: After his son is set upon by a scarecrow that seems to have come alive, farmer Jack Taggart Sr. (Ray Wise) and his son, Jack Taggart Jr. (Luke Edwards), go looking for an explanation. Meanwhile, a bus carrying high-school students breaks down nearby, and a creature known as the Creeper (Jonathan Breck) starts a killing spree. programme.title: Avrupa’da Türk Takımları
programme.desc: UEFA Liga e Evropës (anglisht: UEFA Europa League) është një kompedicion i përvitshëm futbollistik i organizuar nga UEFA që nga viti 1971 ku konkurojnë klubet evropiane. Klubet kualifikohen në këtë kompedicion bazuar në performancat e tyre në ligat dhe kupat kombëtare përkatëse. Është kompedicioni i dytë për nga rëndësia nga UEFA, duke u renditur mbrapa UEFA Ligës së Kampioneve.

programme.title: Spor Gündemi
programme.desc: Detajet e ndeshjeve të ligës profesionale dhe amatore, komentet pas ndeshjes, intervistat ekskluzive, rezultatet e ndeshjeve dhe renditja janë të gjitha në axhendën sportive.

programme.title: Şampiyonlar Ligi Özel
programme.desc: Liga e Kampionëve është kompeticioni kryesor vjetor i UEFA-s për klubet e futbollit, që bashkon ekipet më të mira nga ligat kombëtare të Evropës. E themeluar në vitin 1955 si Kupa e Klubeve Kampione të Evropës dhe e riemërtuar në vitin 1992, ajo ka evoluar nga një turne me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë në një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, të pasuar nga raunde me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë dhe një finale me një ndeshje të vetme. Kualifikimi bazohet kryesisht në paraqitjen në ligat kombëtare dhe në koeficientët e federatave anëtare të UEFA-s, ndërsa kompeticioni përfaqëson nivelin më të lartë të futbollit evropian për klube. Fituesi shpallet kampion i Evropës për klube dhe kualifikohet gjithashtu për kompeticione të tjera të rëndësishme të UEFA-s dhe FIFA-s.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: Die erfolgreiche Werbeagentur "Three Roses" dreht mit Rex einen Werbefilm für ein Tierheim. Charlie ist aus alten Zeiten gut mit Melissa, einer der drei Inhaberinnen bekannt. programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Die Liebesinsel der Zwergpinguine
programme.desc: Es wird heiß in Down Under! Auf Australiens größter Insel suchen die Zwergpinguine nach Liebe, aber Autos, Katzen und Menschen mit Kameras beeinträchtigen die Partnersuche. Werden die kleinsten Pinguine der Welt trotz aller Widrigkeiten Erfolg haben oder die Paarungszeit alleine verbringen? Werden sie eine Familie gründen können? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Gemeinsam mit YouTube-Kollegin Lexie Limitless, die bereits mit 21 Jahren alle Länder der Welt bereist hat, erkundet Josh das französische Nantes auf einem mechanischen Elefanten und auf Inline-Skates. programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: In Thessaloniki, der zweitgrößten Stadt Griechenlands, bewegt sich Cody abseits der ausgetretenen Pfade. Auf einem Zug-Friedhof spaziert er über die ausrangierten Wagons. Und als ob das noch nicht aufregend genug wäre, besucht er noch eine Drohnenfabrik und taucht sogar zu einem Schiffswrack hinunter. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh macht sich auf ins Ruhrgebiet, wo verlassene Stahlfabriken und Bergwerke einen Einblick in das Leben eines Bergmannes bieten. Begleitet wird er dabei vom niederländischen YouTuber und Abenteurer Govert Sweep, der immer auf der Suche nach dem nächsten Urban-Exploring-Kick ist. Werden sie tief unter der Erde auf ihre Kosten kommen? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Die Isle of Wight im Süden Englands ist dank ihrer schönen Natur und des angenehmen Klimas vor allem als Ferienort sehr beliebt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ich kauf mir ein Schloss
programme.desc: Europa ist der Kontinent der Schlösser, Burgen und Gutshäuser – doch viele der Prachtbauten aus einer anderen Zeit sind verlassen und verfallen. Aber sie erleben ein Comeback. Doch die "Schlossrettung" ist meist eine Lebensaufgabe mit vielen Überraschungen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Neue Heimat Mars
programme.desc: Als junger Planet war der Mars lebensfreundlicher. Man nimmt an, dass sich auf seiner Oberfläche Wasser (Jezero-Krater) befand. Als Ressource für künftige Expeditionen unerlässlich, einst Grundlage für Leben? Grüne Männchen eher nicht, wie Evolutionsbiologe Dr. Scott Solomon spekuliert.

programme.title: Neue Heimat Mars
programme.desc: Die erste Reise eines Menschen zum Mars scheint in greifbarer Nähe. Die Geschichte hinter den Technologien, die einen Besuch auf unserem Nachbarplaneten ermöglichen könnten, reicht von Nikola Tesla über die Kriegswaffen der Nazis, den Wettlauf ins All und schließlich bis hin zu den bahnbrechenden Entdeckungen der berühmten Mars-Rover. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Neue Heimat Mars
programme.desc: Schon bald könnte der Traum von einer Reise zum Mars Wirklichkeit werden. Doch wie wird das Leben auf dem roten Planeten dann aussehen? Kann der Mensch es schaffen, in dieser kahlen und lebensfeindlichen Umgebung mit ungewohnt hoher Strahlenbelastung und giftigem Staub ausreichend Nahrung, Wasser und Schutz zu finden? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mission: Ausserirdischer Ozean
programme.desc: Im Oktober 2024 startete die NASA-Raumsonde Europa Clipper auf ihre lange Reise zum Jupitermond Europa, wo sie im April 2030 ankommen soll. Unter der eisigen Oberfläche des Mondes befindet sich ein Salzwasserozean. Die Sonde soll diesen Ozean untersuchen und erforschen, ob es dort Orte gibt, die Leben ermöglichen könnten. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Die Erde – ein Planet im Portrait
programme.desc: Die Auftaktfolge des Dreiteilers widmet sich der Luft. Dass Tier und Mensch das Gasgemisch, das uns umströmt, nicht nur zum Atmen brauchen, zeigen Aufnahmen von Meeresvögeln, die ganze Monate in der Luft verbringen, im Flug schlafen und nur landen, um zu brüten. Außerdem gäbe es ohne eine Lufthülle keinen Schutz vor der gefährlichen UV-Strahlung der Sonne oder vor den Felsbrocken aus dem All. Luft

programme.title: Die Erde – ein Planet im Portrait
programme.desc: Unsere Erde ist kein starrer Planet, sondern in einem unaufhörlichen Wandel begriffen – wie zahllose Vulkane und Geysire rund um den Globus beweisen. So werden Landschaften zerstört, aber es entsteht auch neuer Lebensraum – und wird mit der Zeit von den verschiedensten Wesen besiedelt. Mit dem Wind gelangen Pflanzensamen auf die jungfräulichen Erde – und die Vegetation fasst Fuß. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ein Mammut-Projekt
programme.desc: Forscher:innen arbeiten weltweit an der Wiederbelebung ausgestorbener Tiere. Durch Funde im aufgetauten Permafrost Sibiriens gelang es, die DNA von Mammuts zu rekonstruieren. Mithilfe dieser DNA könnte Asiatischen Elefanten eine höhere Kälteresistenz verliehen werden. Die Forschung ist allerdings ethisch sehr umstritten. Kritiker:innen warnen vor der Vernachlässigung dringender Naturschutzthemen.\

programme.title: Libellen – funkelnde Jäger
programme.desc: Sie sind nicht nur schön anzusehen, sondern auch noch nützlich. Prachtlibellen erlauben Rückschlüsse auf die Qualität der Gewässer, in denen sie leben. Ihre Abwesenheit lässt Biologen jedenfalls genauer hinschauen.

programme.title: Abenteuer Deutschland
programme.desc: Zwischen Harz und Alpen gibt es seit wenigen Jahren wieder mehr Wald und damit Rückzugsgebiete für Wildschweine, Luchse und andere Tierarten. Die Kamera folgt ihnen durchs Unterholz und entdeckt an Flüssen und Seen außer Bibern weitere Arten.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries – Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Auch junge Bären haben Hunger, und der lässt sich am besten stillen, wenn die Lachse im Herbst aus dem Pazifik zum Katmai-Nationalpark schwimmen. Dann schlagen sich die Braunbären die Bäuche voll, um sich gut auf den Winterschlaf vorzubereiten. \n\n6-teilig, montags.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Casey Anderson und seine Crew wandern landeinwärts, um die zahlreichen Bärenfamilien, die sich zum Fischen versammelt haben, zu beobachten. Dabei treffen sie auf neue, aber auch auf altbekannte Tiere. Die Bären haben eine erstaunliche Vielfalt an Techniken entwickelt, um an die heißbegehrten Lachse zu gelangen. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new midnight show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms.

programme.title: Live: Pardon the Interruption
programme.desc: The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. The pair engage in high-energy discussions, conduct interviews and often argue over topics not even related to sports. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day.

programme.title: Live: Monday Night Countdown
programme.desc: Previewing the Monday Night Football matchup airing later on ESPN. programme.desc: I plagosur dhe i përndjekur nga e kaluara, Robin Hudi (Hugh Jackman) përballet me një botë të pamëshirshme, ku legjenda e tij vihet në dyshim. Kur fati e vë përballë një mundësie të fundit për shpengim, ai duhet të vendosë nëse mund të shpëtojë nga njeriu që është bërë.

programme.title: Mandaloriani dhe Grogu
programme.desc: Pas rënies së Perandorisë, Mandaloriani (Pedro Pascal) dhe Grogu marrin një mision nga Republika e Re për të shpëtuar djalin e një prej emrave më të fuqishëm të botës kriminale. Ndërsa përballen me forcat e mbetura të Perandorisë dhe armiq të rinj, ata nisin një betejë të rrezikshme nëpër galaktikë.

programme.title: Pëshpëritësi
programme.desc: Me Robert De Niro, Michelle Monaghan, Adam Scott. Bazuar në romanin bestseller të Alex North. Kur djali i tij rrëmbehet, një baba kërkon ndihmën e të atit, një ish-detektiv, për ta gjetur. Hetimi i çon drejt një vrasësi serial të njohur si ”Njeriu që pëshpërit”.

programme.title: Rrugëdalja
programme.desc: Me Russell Crowe dhe Luke Evans. Një emigrant shqiptar në Los Anxhelos, vendos të shesë klubin e tij të natës dhe të tërhiqet nga jeta kriminale. Por, kur grabitet me armë teksa transporton 75 mijë dollarë të një karteli droge, ai gjendet nën presionin e trafikantëve, të cilët kërkojnë paratë e humbura.

programme.title: Toy Story 5
programme.desc: Udi, Bazi dhe miqtë e tyre rikthehen në një aventurë të re. Kur bota e fëmijëve ndryshon dhe teknologjia zë gjithnjë e më shumë vend në jetën e tyre, lodrat përballen me sfida të reja që vënë në provë miqësinë dhe rolin e tyre në jetën e Boni-t. Mes surprizave dhe situatave të papritura, Udi, Bazi dhe shokët e tyre zbulojnë se, edhe kur kohët ndryshojnë, miqësia e vërtetë mbetet përgjithmonë.

programme.title: S0E139 - Për Tim Bir
programme.desc: Serial/ Dramë: Çfarë plani ka thurur Adil Topali për të shpëtuar djalin e tij dhe si do të jetë kundërpërgjigja e Bahriut Umanit? Semës nuk i janë shuar ende shpresat për Seferin dhe niset për ta këmbyer atë me Neshetin, djalin e Adil Topalit.

programme.title: S0E45 - Rënia e Gjetheve
programme.desc: Lejla shkon fshehurazi te familja, por Ferhunde ia zbulon vizitën Oguzit. Pasi Shevketi i kërkon të punojë, Ferhunde siguron një vend në kompaninë e Jamanit, duke shqetësuar Oguzin dhe Xhejdën. Nexhla afrohet me Xhemin, por qëndrimet e tij për paranë dhe pavarësinë e befasojnë.

programme.title: S0E184 - Pothuajse i Famshëm
programme.desc: Kriza e zemrës e rikthen Selahatinin pranë familjes, por sjellja e tij pas ndërhyrjes ua vë durimin në provë. Përgatitjet për fejesën e Denizit me Rizën nisin mes planeve për një ekspozitë dhe përpjekjeve për ta ndarë çiftin me magji. Një ofertë për album mbërrin pikërisht kur Tylaji mëson se duhet të operojë kordat e zërit.

programme.title: S0E108 - Nëna Ime
programme.desc: Familje: Zejnepi dhe Musai vendosin të bashkohen për të shpëtuar familjen. Barëshi shkon të takojë Ismailin pë t’i kërkuar të largohet nga Derja. Gonxha i rrëfen Basharit se do të largohet për pak kohë te nëna e saj. Si e pret Bashari këtë vendim të Gonxhas?

programme.title: S0E19 - Dashuri Bardhezi
programme.desc: Ferhati qëllohet me armë dhe gjithçka filmohet me dron. A do të mundet Asllëja ta shpëtojë atë? Shahini merr në telefon Namikun dhe i thotë se Ferhati ka vdekur. Jigiti dhe të gjithë të tjetër e mësojnë me dhimbje të madhe lajmin.

programme.title: S0E140 - Për Tim Bir
programme.desc: Serial/ Dramë: Bahri Umani arrin më në fund të shtijë në dorë Adil Topalin duke përdorur si karrem djalin e tij. Songyli dhe Ipeku përpiqen të zhdukin trupin e Selçukut. Çfarë do të bëjë Nesheti për të zënë vendin e babait të tij?

programme.title: S0E46 - Rënia e Gjetheve
programme.desc: Për hir të Lejlës, Ali Riza e pranon Oguzin në shtëpi, një vendim që e lëndon thellë Fikretin. Shevketi kundërshton punësimin e Ferhundes në kompaninë e Jamanit, ndërsa Sedefi provon fatin në një përzgjedhje për reklamë. Provokimet e Ferhundes e çojnë përplasjen me Fikretin në prag të dhunës.

programme.title: S0E185 - Pothuajse i Famshëm
programme.desc: Pas operacionit, Tylaji përpiqet të mos humbasë mundësinë për album, megjithëse e ka të ndaluar të flasë. Selahatini përfundon në polici dhe mëson se dikush ka përdorur dokumentet e tij për mashtrime.

programme.title: S0E109 - Nëna Ime
programme.desc: Familje: Bashari i rikthehet heroinës. Ai i kërkon Gonxhas të largohet nga shtëpia, por ajo nuk pranon ta lërë vetëm. Vendimi i Gonxhas krijon konflikte mes Musait dhe Zejnepin. Mehemti nuk e pranon faktin që motra e tij, Zejnepi të kthehet me Musain dhe i mban qëndrim.

programme.title: S0E20 - Dashuri Bardhezi
programme.desc: Ferhati ndodhet në sallën e operacionit dhe gjendja e tij është kritike. Të gjithë të trishtuar presin lajm nga Asllëja. Namiku dhe Idili debatojnë ashpër. Abedini e gjen Gylsymin në dhomen e tij duke mbajtur foshnjën në krahë. Ferhati përmendet dhe kërkon të kthehet menjëherë në shtëpi….

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: 救參的士
programme.desc: 沒有學霸背景的黑仔外交官敏俊一直無法脫離中東分局, 某天接聽了於黎巴嫩失蹤超過一年的外交官同事的暗號, 為了一展抱負到美國分局工作, 只好親自請纓到黎巴嫩部署億萬贖金的救參行動!敏俊帶著鉅額贖款隻身前往黎巴嫩, 誤打誤撞上了韓籍的士司機兼騙子潘秀的車, 更招來軍隊及黑幫攔途截劫, 被迫殺入子彈橫飛的奪命公路!身處黎巴嫩的敏俊每一秒都在鬥智鬥力, 到底單憑二人之力可否完成國家級任務?

programme.title: 影人映語
programme.desc: 上一集洪金寶暢談了自己在影壇逾半個世紀擔任武術指導、導演及演員的心跡。今集聚焦在大哥的師徒生涯, 大談于占元師父的人生哲理、以及後來自己培育打仔、打女的心路歷程, 並審視現時香港動作電影的困境。

programme.title: 死亡遊戲
programme.desc: 中國功夫超級明星盧比利, 武技精湛舉世知名, 事業正達高峰, 因而引致一個操控藝人的犯罪集團所注意。組織首領藍博士, 欲羅致動作影星盧比利和其歌手女友, 而比利深知藍之為人, 拒與簽事業與前程遭到比利拒絕, 於是他們便在比利拍片時, 換上真子彈, 將之置諸死地...

programme.title: 少年黃飛鴻之鐵馬騮
programme.desc: 清末, 江浙泛災, 惜官商勾結, 平民百姓生活困苦, 幸有俠盜鐵馬騮夜劫貪官濟貧民, 富商遂聘少林叛徒衍空假扮欽差捉拿鐵。其時, 黃麒英與子飛鴻北上辦貨, 無辜被捲入漩渦, 並被要脅往捉拿鐵。惟英從百姓口中得悉鐵乃劫富濟貧的俠盜, 故感左右為難...

programme.title: 海狼
programme.desc: -艘菲律賓貨輪在香港泊岸, 海關人員循例登船檢查, 突然遇襲, 一名匿藏船上的男子Gary打傷海關人員, 逃到岸上。接連數日在碼頭附近發生多宗兇殺案, 兇手身份及行兇動機未明。香港警隊楊麗青督察接手調查, 她從各點蛛絲馬跡中推斷, 行兇者與當日逃去無蹤的Gary有關。該輪船的船長Captain與其弟John指稱Gary是他們在公海救起的難民, 他失憶及有暴力傾向。警方高層向楊麗青下達指示, 要對此暴徒加緊追捕, 必要時, 為了全港市民的安寧着想, 可以執行格殺令。疑兇Gary四處躲藏警方的緝捕, 由於失憶, 對自己過去的一切完全空白, 加上對香港陌生, 本能上只懂得以暴力自衛, 變成千夫所指的頭號危險人物。楊麗青加緊追查行動, 從綫報得知Gary藏於一妓女家中, 楊麗青精密部署, 準備將他一舉擒獲, 怎料在現場連船長之弟John亦一併逮住...

programme.title: 暗戰
programme.desc: 只十四日壽命的華, 決定要與警方玩一場七十二小時的遊戲, 打劫珠寶公司之餘, 還脅持人質。警員生覺得華這次行動是衝著自己而來, 幾番波折, 華最後落網。其實華與生暗地裡正惺惺相惜, 生知華時日無多, 遂設法放走華...

programme.title: 對不起，多謝你
programme.desc: 李立昌, 又名卸膊昌, 一個不成熟, 不長進, 無'吉士', 不懂得向人說'對不起'和'多謝', 甚至為了生活放棄自尊的'爛坦', 昌少年時與葉婷結合, 生有一子, 葉婷隨著年月人生觀改變, 知道盲目追求愛情, 不及麵包重要, 終向昌提出離異, 與兒子JASON移民加拿大, 重新生活。葉婷為了解決JASON撫養權, 向昌發律師信爭取, 昌為爭一時之氣, 在葉婷帶JASON回港時, 要求與親子生活一段時間, 父子相處期間, 從矛盾衝突中慢慢產生感情, 親情, 昌的父親責任感萌生...

programme.title: 花仔多情
programme.desc: 阿倫經營著一家小小的花店, 在女友決定離開他後, 阿倫很長一段時間都生活在心碎之中。阿蘭從很久以前起就默默的暗戀著阿倫, 藉此機會她想要乘虛而入。於是, 在哥哥一丈紅的安排之下, 阿蘭灌醉了阿倫, 和他發生了關係。雖然阿倫對阿蘭沒有任何感情, 但負責任的他還是決定開始和阿蘭交往。阿倫帶著阿蘭前往日本旅遊, 在旅途中, 阿倫邂逅了美麗的幸子, 幸子一下子就牢牢的抓住了阿倫的心, 阿倫向幸子展開了熱烈的追求, 很快, 兩人就墜入了愛河之中...

programme.title: 七年之癢
programme.desc: 吳德威與張小妹同居剛滿七年, 小妹持家有道, 惟她醉心於粵劇, 常惹吳討厭。而吳的個性內向, 七年來從不敢拈花惹草, 但漸感家庭生活枯燥無味, 加上同事及其妻舅父John之推波助瀾, 吳漸感「七年之癢」。一次吳赴新加坡公幹, 遇一女扒手小紅因被警察追蹤, 將珠寶巧計放入吳之行李內。小紅為奪回珠寶, 向吳大施美人計, 小紅趁機取回珠寶, 臨行前留下絕情書一封, 吳以為小紅不忍破壞其家庭幸福, 竟大為感動, 對小紅念念不忘。吳提議與妻到新加坡渡假, 實則只為回味一段霧水情緣。誰料旅途上一中年富翁多多大力追求小妹...

programme.title: 蠍子戰士
programme.desc: 費柴攜子玉書來到香港, 並以剪髮維生。費柴一生寄望在玉書身上, 希望他能習醫, 但玉書無心向學, 終日沉迷畫漫畫, 富正義感的他更好抱不平, 經常強出頭而受傷。某日, 玉書於華探長家中遇上丫鬟小茹, 對其一見傾心, 更發現華探長與黑幫勾結販賣人口, 及後見到王老爺欲對小茹不軌, 玉書一時大怒並救走小茹, 得罪華探長的他, 幸得Jean-Paul相救, 並認定Jean-Paul為其偶像, 希望有朝一日能在其門下學武。及後他們被阿一牛河的阿一收留, 原以為只是一間普通的牛河店, 但玉書卻在無意之中學得一身功夫, 更拜阿一為師, 二人一同去對抗惡勢力...

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: 吳醫生帶同太太、小女兒小魔怪及前妻所生的一雙兒女吳理及吳彩到郊外野餐, 就在這天起, 吳家各人都惹上似是而非的羅曼史︰首先是兒子吳理被一個惹火尤物、新潮性感的麥當娜吸引；小魔怪對一個身手靈活、勇猛正義的小泰龍心生仰慕；大女兒吳彩愛上失業留學生表哥。吳太不理丈夫反對, 參加話劇團招考演員。話劇團導演, 即小泰龍的失婚爸爸, 對吳太一見鍾情, 選她擔任女主角, 期間展開追求。一日, 在吳醫生的生日派對上, 發現表哥與麥當娜是重逢的舊戀人, 吳家兄妹同嚐失戀之苦...

programme.title: Apolline matin
programme.desc: Inédit. Apolline de Malherbe donne rendez-vous aux auditeurs de RMC et téléspectateurs de RMC Découverte pour une nouvelle matinale d' info : " Apolline matin ". Explications, débats et bonne humeur pour tout savoir, tout comprendre et se faire sa propre opinion. programme.title: Les grandes gueules
programme.desc: Inédit. Sous la direction d'Alain Marschall et d'Olivier Truchot, Les grandes gueules invitent régulièrement des interlocuteurs qui reflètent la société française dans toute sa variété et qui traitent sans tabou toutes les thématiques de la vie quotidienne qui marquent l'actualité. Une émission qui est au centre de plusieurs polémiques.

programme.title: Estelle midi : on ne va pas se mentir
programme.desc: Inédit. Du lundi au vendredi de 12h à 15h, Estelle Denis reçoit des invités qui apportent leurs savoirs, leurs enquêtes mais aussi leurs point de vue sur l'actualité. L'émission aborde tous les sujets du moment qui font débat mais aussi des sujets au plus près du quotidien des Français et qui sont au coeur de leurs préoccupations : la famille, le travail, l'école, ou encore la vie de couple.

programme.title: Ovnis : Les dossiers secret défense
programme.desc: Au cours des 70 années qui se sont écoulées depuis la célèbre affaire de Roswell, il y a eu une longue série d'allégations concernant des phénomènes extraterrestres et leur supposée dissimulation par les gouvernements. Ce documentaire examine de près les rapports d'ovnis les plus célèbres et les moins connus qui, selon certains, ont été délibérément cachés au public.

programme.title: Sommes-nous seuls dans l'univers ?
programme.desc: La Voie lactée n'est qu'une des galaxies parmi des milliers, des milliards, voire des centaines de milliards. L'infinité de l'univers dépasse l'imagination. La question fondamentale se pose alors : comment envisager que la Terre soit la seule planète à abriter la vie ? Etre seul dans le cosmos semblerait relever d'un hasard inouï, avec une probabilité estimée à 1 sur 10 000 milliards de milliards.

programme.desc: Le film est inspiré d'un événement réel, lorsqu'en 1969, le célèbre tableau du Caravage, La Nativité avec les saints Laurent et François d'Assise, a été volé A Palerme dans des circonstances mystérieuses.

programme.title: The Bad Guy
programme.desc: Après avoir échoué à arrêter Suro et son humiliation publique, la vie de Nino Scotellaro est arrivée à une impasse. La mafia lui a tout pris : sa dignité, son amour et sa liberté mais le destin lui accorde une seconde chance. Nino retourne en Sicile sous les traits de Balduccio Remora, un cousin d'Amérique du Sud, pour accomplir sa vengeance.

programme.title: Medici in corsia
programme.desc: Le docteur Niklas Ahrend quitte la Sachsenklinik après une expérience bouleversante mais aussi à la demande pressante de son mentor, le Docteur Harald Loosen, qui lui propose un poste de médecin-chef à Erfurt à la clinique Johannes Thal. Il y rencontre le Dr Leyla Sherbaz avec qui il a fait son internat et se voit chargé de la supervision des nouveaux internes par le professeur Karin Patzelt.

programme.title: La grande vallata
programme.desc: A la fin du XIXe siècle, la saga de la famille Barkley. Veuve énergique, Victoria Barkley dirige le ranch et sa famille d'une main de fer. Elle est aidée dans sa tâche par ses 3 fils, sa fille et le fils illégitime de son mari disparu.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Sur la plage de Malibu, dans le sud de la Californie, la LA Country Beach Patrol est chargée de la surveillance. Chaque jour, le lieutenant Mitch Bucannon et son équipe d'une dizaine de sauveteurs font face aux dangers de la mer et de la plage. programme.desc: During a hallucinatory incident, young Kristen Parker (Patricia Arquette) has her wrists slashed by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). One of the doctors there is Nancy Thompson (Heather Langenkamp), who had battled Freddy some years before. Nancy senses a potential in Kristen to rid the world of Freddy once and for all.

programme.desc: The fifth installment of the popular franchise focuses on Alice (Lisa Wilcox), a survivor of the fourth, who believes Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund) has been eliminated for good. programme.title: Les secrets des bâtisseurs de pyramides

Në edicionin qendror të lajmeve ndër vite janë ekspozuar skandalet më të mëdha, keqpërdorimet enorme, gëzimet, festat, por edhe fatkeqësitë e popullit të Kosovës.

Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: Do Sandomierza przyjeżdża aktorka Maria Brodzka z mężem reżyserem, by wystawić spektakl według "Anny Kareniny" Tołstoja. Tytułową rolę gra Maria. Podczas prób dochodzi do wypadku. Policja podejrzewa, że ktoś chce pozbyć się Marii.

programme.title: Silny jak twierdza
programme.desc: Historia jednego z najbardziej znanych chorałów ewangelickich obecnych do dziś w kulturze muzycznej. To właśnie XVI - wieczne "Warownym grodem" Marcina Lutra jest znakomitym przykładem nowopowstałej formy muzycznej, pomyślanej jako liturgiczno - użytkowa, a 200 lat później doprowadzonej do postaci arcydzieła przez Jana Sebastiana Bacha.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Projekt trzynastu etiud filmowych przybliżających widzom sylwetki wybitnych polskich naukowców żyjących w różnych zakątkach świata, którzy swoją pracą i odkryciami dali podstawy do rozwoju nauki. W krótkich filmach poznamy niezwykłe historie wybitnych Polaków, którzy pomimo odległości, jaka ich dzieliła od Ojczyzny, sercem oddani byli Polsce, ale swoim umysłem i talentem służyli innym narodom.

programme.title: Zaginione? Ocalone? Historie zawodów różnych
programme.desc: Praczka, śledziarz, handlarz starzyzną czy ostrzyciel noży odeszli w zapomnienie. Taki los może czekać wikliniarzy, bednarzy, kołodziejów. W niektórych przypadkach to ostatni moment, by rzemieślnicy podzielili się swoimi umiejętnościami.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Kapitan próbuje zbliżyć się do Sylwii. Sprzyja mu los. Po porannej zaprawie odkrywa w trawie rannego bociana. Wzywa Sylwię do woliery, do pacjenta. Udaje im się dłużej porozmawiać. Kapitan opowiada jej o swojej pracy na morzu.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Sylwia jest w szoku. Kapitan Karol mówi jej, że prawdopodobnie jest jej ojcem. Chciałaby powiedzieć o tym Dawidowi, ale ten jedzie z doktorem do Białegostoku. Próbuje rozmawiać z księdzem, z przyjaciółkami Jagną i Majką.

programme.title: Zmiennicy
programme.desc: Wśród pasażerów samolotu z Bangkoku, którzy czekają na odprawę celną, jest Krashan ze "swoim towarem". Tego dnia jest wzmożona kontrola, więc nawiązuje kontakt ze strażakiem Kuśmidrem, by mu pomógł wynieść "trefny" bagaż z lotniska.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Polska bizneswoman, mecenas sztuki, innowatorka i twórczyni nowoczesnej kosmetologii, założycielka przedsiębiorstwa Helena Rubinstein Inc. , jedna z najbogatszych kobiet swojej epoki. Działała na terenie Stanów Zjednoczonych.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Miras odkrywa nową pasję - psychoterapię! Niestety, zamiast pomóc, wpędza wszystkich w jeszcze większy chaos. Tymczasem Patrycja przygotowuje się do roli w horrorze psychologicznym i przypadkowo odkrywa swój największy lęk. Sytuacja wymyka się spod kontroli, gdy na terapię trafia sąsiad - jedyny człowiek bez żadnych problemów, co sprawia, że to Miras przechodzi załamanie.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Dominika wchodzi w konflikt z Renatą. Spór dotyczy finansów, podziału zysków z lokalu Feel Good oraz przyszłości ich spółki. Damian radzi Kowalskiej oddzielenie relacji zawodowych od prywatnych i sugeruje pozbawienie wspólniczki udziałów.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane i takie, które nie są niedostępne dla wszystkich. W odcinku: Elektrownia Powiśle.

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Dziewczyny szantażują Dietriecha i żądają współpracy z podziemiem. On się zgadza. Ewka decyduje, że zamieszkają razem w mieszkaniu Felicji. Dziewczyny spotykają Malinę, który prosi Ewkę o wyrobienie kenkart dla 2 Żydów z getta.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: Andrzej i Basia są szczęśliwi na początku małżeństwa. Nie zdają sobie sprawy z rozterek, jakie przeżywają Lawinowie, ilekroć odbierają listy od Łukasza z Kanady. Andrzej popada w konflikt z uczelnianą organizacją ZMP.

programme.title: Lato z Radiem i Telewizją Polską
Polacy światu
programme.desc: Polska bizneswoman, mecenas sztuki, innowatorka i twórczyni nowoczesnej kosmetologii, założycielka przedsiębiorstwa Helena Rubinstein Inc. , jedna z najbogatszych kobiet swojej epoki. Działała na terenie Stanów Zjednoczonych.

programme.title: Moda na język polski
programme.desc: "Moda na język polski" to literacko - językowe podróże po Polsce. Autorzy programu sprawdzają jak mówią mieszkańcy naszego kraju, przedstawiciele różnych grup społecznych i zawodowych. I odkrywają na nowo twórczość znanych pisarzy.

programme.title: Przez pamięć i zapomnienie
programme.desc: Podróż przez polskie miasta i miasteczka - niegdyś tętniące życiem ośrodki społeczności żydowskiej - inspirowana książką Mordechaja Canina "Wśród ruin i popiołów".

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Policjanci badają sprawę zabójstwa ekologa, który sprzeciwiał się budowie spalarni. Głównym podejrzanym jest burmistrz, ale ofiara otrzymywała też liczne groźby w Internecie.

programme.title: Je suis un tueur
programme.desc: Dans les années 70, en Pologne, un jeune policier ambitieux tente d'arrêter l'auteur de meurtres en série qui ensanglantent une ville ouvrière.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane i takie, które nie są niedostępne dla wszystkich. W odcinku: Elektrownia Powiśle.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Dominika wchodzi w konflikt z Renatą. Spór dotyczy finansów, podziału zysków z lokalu Feel Good oraz przyszłości ich spółki. Damian radzi Kowalskiej oddzielenie relacji zawodowych od prywatnych i sugeruje pozbawienie wspólniczki udziałów.

programme.title: Pożyteczni.pl
programme.desc: Magazyn reporterski, opisujący działalność organizacji pożytku publicznego i formy aktywności obywatelskiej. Pokazuje energię i kreatywność ludzi, którzy sami postanowili zmienić i wzbogacić rzeczywistość wokół siebie i pomóc sobie i innym w rozwiązywaniu problemów, które wydawały się nie do pokonania.

programme.title: Szlakiem miejsc niezwykłych - pomniki historii
programme.desc: W kolejnym reportażu prezentującym najciekawsze pomniki i zabytki polskiej kultury pokazane zostały: Gdańsk, Gdynia i Westerplatte, czyli trzy różne wymiary polskości na Pomorzu.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Policjanci badają sprawę zabójstwa ekologa, który sprzeciwiał się budowie spalarni. Głównym podejrzanym jest burmistrz, ale ofiara otrzymywała też liczne groźby w Internecie.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Kusy z pasją walczy o czystość w domu, by nie dopuścić do córeczki choroby zakaźnej. Jego bezwzględność prowadzi do konfliktów. Wikary skarcony przez księdza, że kapłańską misję zredukował do pośrednictwa pracy, ewangelizuje gminę.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Stanisław Michał Jankowski pseudonim "Agaton" urodził się 29 września 1911 roku w Warszawie. Wybitny architekt, uczestnik kampanii wrześniowej 1939 roku, cichociemny, powstaniec warszawski, adiutant gen. Tadeusza "Bora" Komorowskiego.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Gwałtowna awaria prądu rzuca rodzinę Sylwestra w średniowiecze. Zero internetu, zero elektroniki - tylko świeczki, rozmowy i prawdziwe relacje. Dzieci są przerażone, Sylwester widzi w tym szansę, a Miras próbuje na tym zarobić. Czy blackout stanie się początkiem nowej rodzinnej tradycji?

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Rawiczowa odkrywa, że łączy ją z Basią wiele wspólnych tematów, a jej relacja z Tolkiem ulega wyraźnemu zacieśnieniu. Z kolei Klemens uświadamia Dominice powagę sytuacji i ryzyko, jakie niesie za sobą dalsza współpraca z Renatą.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane i takie, które nie są niedostępne dla wszystkich. Miejsca skrywające wiele tajemnic, miejsca o bogatej historii. Prowadzący przenoszą widza do minionych epok jednocześnie uwzględniając starania i dokonania współczesnych konserwatorów, historyków oraz pasjonatów histor

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Ania i Mania szykują się do matury. Po egzaminach Mania jest zdecydowana wrócić do Brwinowa, Anię bardziej niż stabilizacja, pociąga dalsza edukacja. Paweł po raz kolejny próbuje zawalczyć o Anię i wpłynąć na zmianę jej planów.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: Zostaje zamordowany Jakub Gold, jeden z kandydatów na burmistrza w trwającej kampanii wyborczej. Był przedstawicielem mniejszości żydowskiej, w programie swojej kampanii stawiał na ekologię. Możejko poszukuje partnerki dla swojego psa.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Stanisław Michał Jankowski pseudonim "Agaton" urodził się 29 września 1911 roku w Warszawie. Wybitny architekt, uczestnik kampanii wrześniowej 1939 roku, cichociemny, powstaniec warszawski, adiutant gen. Tadeusza "Bora" Komorowskiego.

programme.title: Z Gliwic do Paryża - Wojtek Pszoniak
programme.desc: Dokument przedstawia sylwetkę Wojciecha Pszoniaka. Jego rodzina przed drugą wojną światową mieszkała we Lwowie. Po 1945 roku Pszoniakowie przenieśli się do Gliwic.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Miras odkrywa nową pasję - psychoterapię! Niestety, zamiast pomóc, wpędza wszystkich w jeszcze większy chaos. Tymczasem Patrycja przygotowuje się do roli w horrorze psychologicznym i przypadkowo odkrywa swój największy lęk. Sytuacja wymyka się spod kontroli, gdy na terapię trafia sąsiad - jedyny człowiek bez żadnych problemów, co sprawia, że to Miras przechodzi załamanie.

programme.title: Polacy na ratunek Żydom
programme.desc: Bohaterem reportażu jest o. Marian Masłowski, jezuita. Jego rodzice w czasie niemieckiej okupacji pomagali dużej grupie Żydów.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: S0E13 - Kandidatja
programme.desc: Oçoa kërcënon nënën e Ugos të mos dëshmojë kundër djalit të guvernatorit. Teresa bën rolin e viktimës e akuzon Himenën për tradhti. Mario vret pa mëshirë Suzanën.

programme.title: Ftesë në Pesë
programme.desc: Programi i pasdites në Top Channel, është një program sa informues aq edhe argëtues që ndërthur intervista, aktualitet, histori njerëzore dhe tema që prekin jetën e përditshme. Me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, personazhe publike dhe njerëz me histori frymëzuese, programi sjell biseda të sinqerta, emocione, debat dhe këndvështrime të ndryshme mbi çështje sociale, kulturore dhe të aktualitetit, në një atmosferë të ngrohtë dhe komunikim të drejtpërdrejtë me publikun.

programme.title: Per’Puthen
programme.desc: Eshtë një program që vendos në qendër njohjet, flirtin dhe marrëdhëniet mes të rinjve që kërkojnë dashurinë. Djem dhe vajza, që njihen me njëri- tjetrin në ekran, për të përmbushur qëllimin e nje dashurie, të ndërtuar në sytë e publikut. Takimet, pëlqimet, xhelozitë, rivalitetet dhe debatet krijojnë dinamika të papritura, ndërsa historitë e personazheve zhvillohen natyrshëm përpara publikut.

programme.title: Lajmet, moti
programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore te dites nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Shqipëria tjetër
programme.desc: Eshtë një cikël reportazhesh në Top Channel, që zbulon anën e panjohur të vendit përmes historive njerëzore, vendeve të veçanta dhe realiteteve të ndryshme nga çdo cep i Shqipërisë. Përmes udhëtimeve në terren, rrëfimeve të banorëve dhe pasqyrimit të traditave, problemeve dhe përpjekjeve të komuniteteve, reportazhet sjellin në ekran një Shqipëri autentike, shpesh të padukshme, me historitë dhe problemet e njerëzve të saj.

programme.title: Fiks fare
programme.desc: Programi i pare investigativ ne median shqiptare fokusuar ne korrupsionin e padrejtesite, trafikimin e abuzimet me pushtetin, problemet ekonomike, sociale si dhe hallet e ndryshme te njerezve. Fiks Fare trajton problematikat e qytetarëve, denoncon abuzimet, korrupsionin dhe shkeljet institucionale, duke i sjellë ato në vëmendjen e publikut dhe autoriteteve.

programme.title: Top story
programme.desc: Top Story është programi kryesor i debatit dhe analizës në Top Channel, i cili trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme të aktualitetit politik, ekonomik, social dhe ndërkombëtar. Përmes intervistave ekskluzive, debateve me të ftuar, analizave dhe raportimeve të thelluara, programi ofron një pasqyrë të plotë të zhvillimeve që ndikojnë në jetën publike.

programme.title: Proçesi sportiv
programme.desc: Sporti vjen cdo të hënë në ekranin tuaj me një show të jashtëzakonshem. Proces, analizë, debat, opinion, reagime dhe gjithcka tjetër nga bota e madhe dhe e larmishme e sportit. Por mbi të gjitha, pasqyrimi i evenimenteve sportive brenda dhe jashtë vendit. Të ftuar: specialistët më të mirë, gazetarët më të njohur, të ftuar të ndryshem, rubrika të reja.

programme.title: Gold Rush Maisie
programme.desc: Driving along on her way to a gig at the Hula Parlor Café, Maisie Ravier (Ann Sothern) is stalled when she has engine troubles. She is forced to hitchhike into town, only to discover that the job's already been taken. On the upside, Maisie hears about a gold rush just outside the area and decides to go into business with the Davises, a family of poor prospectors, as well as Bill Anders (Lee Bowman), a crotchety ranch owner who may be unknowingly sitting on a valuable vein of gold.

programme.title: Maisie Gets Her Man
programme.desc: Chicago showgirl Maisie Ravier (Ann Sothern) falls on hard times and begins a job working for Pappy (Allen Jenkins), a decent building manager. When she ends up getting them both fired, she lands a new position as an assistant to an aspiring comedian, Hap (Red Skelton). Hap's failings on stage, however, leave them in need of another job: working for a con man (Lloyd Corrigan) who bottles tap water. Eventually, Maisie and Hap fall for each other, but he still has a fiancée back home.

programme.title: The Barbarian
programme.desc: An Egyptian-American woman (Myrna Loy) runs around Cairo with a desert charmer (Ramon Novarro) who turns out to be a prince.

programme.title: When Ladies Meet
programme.desc: Reporter Jimmie Lee (Robert Montgomery) suspects his long-time girlfriend, successful novelist Mary Howard (Myrna Loy), of having a romance with her married publisher, Rogers Woodruf (Frank Morgan). While Mary works on her latest novel -- about a married woman allowing her husband to desert her for his mistress -- Jimmie meets Woodruf's wife, Clare (Ann Harding). Realizing she is unaware of her husband's affair, he convinces Clare to meet Mary while pretending to be his new girlfriend.

programme.title: Penthouse
programme.desc: After lawyer Jackson Durant (Warner Baxter) successfully defends racketeer Tony Gazotti (Nat Pendleton), Durant's fiancée, Sue (Martha Sleeper), leaves him. However, she soon needs his help when her new beau, Tom (Phillips Holmes), is accused of killing his old girlfriend (Mae Clarke). Durant takes the case, and, with the help of Gazotti and Gertie (Myrna Loy), the victim's roommate, he determines that crime boss Jim Crelliman (C. Henry Gordon) played a role in the murder.

programme.title: Night Flight
programme.desc: Pilots risk their lives by flying in dangerous weather through the Andes Mountains to deliver medicine to Rio de Janeiro.

programme.title: The Prizefighter and the Lady
programme.desc: Steve (real-life boxer Max Baer) is a brash bartender whose knock-out power is discovered by the Professor (Walter Huston), an alcoholic ex-fight trainer. Working together, they find success in the ring, and Steve begins a whirlwind romance with the sultry Belle (Myrna Loy), a gangster's moll who hastily leaves her man to marry him. Steve's infidelity brings discord to their marriage, but he'll have to overcome these distractions if he's going to succeed in his heavyweight title fight.

programme.title: Men in White
programme.desc: Pressured by long hours filled with life-and-death decisions, medical intern George Ferguson (Clark Gable) grows increasingly exhausted and unsure about his career. After a night call forces him to break another date with fiancée Laura Hudson (Myrna Loy), George takes comfort with nursing student Barbara Dennin (Elizabeth Allan) -- unaware that his mentor, Dr. Hochberg (Jean Hersholt), knows of the liaison. Later, when confronted by Barbara's botched abortion, George must decide his future.

programme.title: Stamboul Quest
programme.desc: From within the confines of a mental institution, Annemarie (Myrna Loy) succumbs to memories of her rocky espionage career. As a German agent during World War I, Annemarie travels to Constantinople to gather information on a Turkish military official. Things go smoothly until she encounters an American medical student named Douglas (George Brent) while on her way to the Middle East. As the spy and the student fall in love, deadly consequences result.

programme.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programme.desc: Fred, Al and Homer are three World War II veterans facing difficulties as they re-enter civilian life. Fred (Dana Andrews) is a war hero who, unable to compete with more highly skilled workers, has to return to his low-wage soda jerk job. Bank executive Al (Fredric March) gets into trouble for offering favorable loans to veterans. After losing both hands in the war, Homer (Harold Russell) returns to his loving fiancée, but must struggle to adjust.

programme.title: The Red Pony
programme.desc: In the Salinas Valley of California, young Tom Tiflin lives on his family's ranch with his parents, Fred and Alice, who are constantly at odds, and with his rambling grandfather. Capturing Tom's admiration, however, is the hired ranch hand, Billy Buck, a venerable horse expert. When his father gives him a pony as a gift, Tom learns the importance of responsibility, but also has to face the pain of loss.

programme.title: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
programme.desc: When advertising executive Jim Blandings discovers his wife's plan to redecorate their New York apartment, he counters with a proposal that they move to Connecticut. She agrees, and the two are soon conned into buying a house that turns out to be a complete nightmare. Construction and repair bills accumulate quickly, and Jim worries that their future hangs in the balance unless he can come up with a catchy new jingle that will sell ham.

programme.title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
programme.desc: Artist playboy Dickie Nugent (Cary Grant) appears before beautiful judge Margaret Turner (Myrna Loy) for fighting at a nightclub, and charms her into dismissing the charge. That same day, Dickie happens to lecture at a high school, where Margaret's teenage sister, Susan (Shirley Temple), falls head-over-heels for him. Things get complicated when Susan sneaks away and is found in Dickie's apartment, and downright zany when he is court ordered to date the teen as a way of easing her attraction.

programme.title: Third Finger, Left Hand
programme.desc: Uninterested in an office romance, successful fashion journalist Margot Sherwood Merrick (Myrna Loy) goes to great lengths to conceal the fact that she's single. To ward off potential beaus, including painter Jeff Thompson (Melvyn Douglas), she wears a fake wedding ring and tells everyone she already has a husband. When Jeff realizes that Margot doesn't have a spouse, he decides to make her pay for her deception by posing as her husband, leading to a comical rivalry and a surprising romance.

programme.title: So Goes My Love
programme.desc: Eccentric British inventor Hiram Maxim (Don Ameche) and his bride (Myrna Loy) raise a son (Bobby Driscoll) in late-1800s Brooklyn.

programme.title: A Successful Calamity
programme.desc: After a year away in Europe, successful financier Henry Wilton (George Arliss) is finally returning home to his wife, Emmy (Mary Astor), daughter Peggy (Evalyn Knapp) and son Eddie, only to discover their lifestyle leaves them much too busy to spend any time together as a family. In a ploy to keep everyone together, Wilton lies about his wealth and announces he's financially ruined. As expected, his family rallies to support his supposed losses, but how long can he keep the charade up?

programme.title: Turn Back the Clock
programme.desc: A cigar-store keeper (Lee Tracy) dreams of what his life would have been like with power, prestige and a rich wife.

programme.title: The Millionaire
programme.desc: Growing bored with life as a retiree, millionaire James Alden (George Arliss) secretly invests in an unprofitable gas station to amuse himself. Disguising himself and using the alias "Charles Miller," James begins a partnership with a young bootstrapper named Bill Merrick (David Manners). Complications arise when James' spoiled daughter, Barbara (Evalyn Knapp), becomes a regular customer and competition from a neighboring gas station threatens to ruin the business.

programme.title: Tycoon
programme.desc: American engineer Johnny Munroe (John Wayne) is hired by South American tycoon Frederick Alexander (Cedric Hardwicke) to bore a tunnel for a new railroad in the Andes Mountains. On the job, he falls for Alexander's beautiful daughter, Maura (Laraine Day). Facing dangerous conditions and serious design challenges, Munroe struggles to complete the job he was hired to do, while simultaneously struggling to convince his skeptical, overprotective employer that he is a worthy suitor for Maura.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Silver Dollar
programme.desc: Yates Martin (Edward G. Robinson) and his wife, Sarah (Aline MacMahon), are struggling to make ends meet as owners of a grocery store in late 19th-century Colorado. When Martin's silver mine strikes it rich, he begins to live the high life, moving to a huge mansion and running for public office. His grandiose ways alienate his wife, however, so he takes up with Lily (Bebe Daniels). Then Martin begins dreaming of running for national office, unaware that his fate will change once again.

programme.title: The World Changes
programme.desc: A young Midwesterner (Paul Muni) becomes a meat tycoon with a socialite wife (Mary Astor).

programme.title: Boom Town
programme.desc: Two rogue Texas oil men, Big John McMasters (Clark Gable) and Square John Sand (Spencer Tracy), drill oil wells in fields where there is no known oil. These wildcatters team up with a local drilling equipment owner, Luther Aldrich (Frank Morgan), and strike it rich -- but the ups and downs of the oil business, the whims of South American politics, and the love of Elizabeth Betsy Bartlett (Claudette Colbert) threaten to tear the two friends apart.

programme.title: The Enchanted Cottage
programme.desc: Disfigured from wounds suffered in war, pilot Oliver Bradford (Robert Young) runs away in shame from his beautiful fiancée (Hillary Brooke) and his mother (Spring Byington). Renting a cottage from the kind-hearted Mrs. Minnett (Mildred Natwick), Oliver meets the plain-looking but gentle housekeeper Laura Pennington (Dorothy McGuire). As the veteran and the maid begin to learn more about one another, they see past their outer imperfections to discover that true beauty lies within.

programme.title: Desire Me
programme.desc: Soldiers Paul Aubert and Jean Renaud attempt to make their escape from a Nazi prison camp, but only Jean makes it out alive. When Jean is dispatched to deliver the sad news to Paul's wife, Marise, he begins a budding romance with the recently widowed woman. Then Paul, injured but still very much alive, sends word that he is coming to reunite with his wife, putting a damper on Jean's plans to start a new life with Marise.

programme.title: The Great Lie
programme.desc: After her long-time boyfriend, pilot Pete Van Allen (George Brent), marries fiery concert pianist Sandra Kovak (Mary Astor) while drunk, Maggie Patterson (Bette Davis) is heartbroken. Pete learns the marriage is illegal, yet dutifully offers to remarry Sandra. But when she refuses to alter a performance date to do so, Pete returns to Maggie and marries her. Soon after, Pete goes missing on a flight -- and when Maggie learns Sandra is carrying Pete's baby, she makes the pianist a shocking offer.

programme.title: Random Harvest
programme.desc: A veteran of World War I, Charles Rainier (Ronald Colman) has lost all memory of his life before the war. Left to wander, Rainier meets a showgirl, Paula (Greer Garson), with whom he falls in love. Rainier and Paula are soon happily married, but when Rainier travels out of town, a car hits him -- erasing the memories of his life with Paula, but restoring those of his life before the war. While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband.

programme.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
programme.desc: Plucky Englishwoman Joan Webster travels to the remote islands of the Scottish Hebrides in order to marry a wealthy industrialist. Trapped by inclement weather on the Isle of Mull and unable to continue to her destination, Joan finds herself charmed by the straightforward, no-nonsense islanders around her, and becomes increasingly attracted to naval officer Torquil MacNeil, who holds a secret that may change her life forever.

programme.title: Dark Victory
programme.desc: Socialite Judith Traherne (Bette Davis) lives a lavish but emotionally empty life. Riding horses is one of her few joys, and her stable master (Humphrey Bogart) is secretly in love with her. Told she has a brain tumor by her doctor, Frederick Steele (George Brent), Judith becomes distraught. After she decides to have surgery to remove the tumor, Judith realizes she is in love with Dr. Steele, but more troubling medical news may sabotage her new relationship, and her second chance at life.

programme.title: They Learned About Women
programme.desc: In this musical, friends Jerry Burke (Gus Van) and Jack Glennon (Joseph T. Schenck) are both baseball players who perform a vaudeville act on the side. Jack attracts the attention of money-hungry Daisy (Mary Doran), who splits up his engagement with sweet Mary (Bessie Love) and his friendship with Jerry. Eventually, Jerry's income is insufficient for Daisy, and she leaves him. Jack, whose team is playing in the World Series, starts dating Mary, but still tries to help his old friend in need.

programme.title: Alibi Ike
programme.desc: With his job on the line, Chicago Cubs manager Cap (William Frawley) needs to turn around his lackluster team fast -- especially since nothing less than the pennant will keep him employed. Fortunately for Cap, rookie pitcher Frank "Ike" Farrell (Joe E. Brown) has just the talent to pull up the fledgling team. However, Ike always has an excuse or a lie handy for every problem -- and the real trouble comes when a group of gamblers look to fix the Cubs' games, and Ike is their main target.

programme.title: The Big Leaguer
programme.desc: Young players try out for the founder (Edward G. Robinson) of the New York Giants Florida training camp.

programme.title: The Pride of the Yankees
programme.desc: This moving biographical drama follows the life of revered baseball player Lou Gehrig (Gary Cooper). Championed by sportswriter Sam Blake (Walter Brennan), Gehrig eventually gets recruited by the New York Yankees, joining a team of heavy hitters that includes the legendary Babe Ruth. When Gehrig marries his spirited sweetheart, Eleanor (Teresa Wright), things look up for him, but he is soon sidelined by a terrible illness that he bravely tries to battle.

programme.title: 急診室的春天第2季:11
programme.desc: 描述一群醫生與護士每天在急診室中與病人間所發生的各種感人故事,由於醫師與護士必須在萬分緊急之中,克制心中的七情六慾與功利私心,並在一瞬間從鬼門關將患者搶救回來,因此這部影集的成功,絕不是高貴的醫師救了多少脆弱的生命,而是類如常人的醫者勇敢面對生命而變得高貴.....

programme.title: 卡那洛效應第2季:1
programme.desc: 麥可卡那洛是一個職業魔 術師， 卻是個愛開玩笑的人，他在一些很平常的場合裡，對一些猜想不到的人表演難解的魔術，全都被隱藏式攝影機拍下。

programme.title: 生活冷知識第1季:5
programme.desc: 歡迎來到由 Kevin Pereira 和 Brooke Van Poppelen 主持的每週節目，該節目以喜劇形式講述了永無止境的日常生活小貼士。 從學習如何用鞋子打開一瓶酒，到找出衛生紙捲的多種用途，永遠不乏有待發現的訣竅。 觀眾請注意：你們的生活將永遠不一樣。
